constraints: Use authorized generated ordinary prime-order short-Weierstrass curves over prime fields of characteristic not 2 or 3.
Separate fixed-curve advice and offline construction from per-target field operations, memory traffic, peak live state, supported targets, and success probability.
Use a registered complete projective addition law and independently replay every returned five-identifier witness.
The positive path must return five signed public factor identifiers, not only a zero predicate or an unlifted tensor index.
Do not treat constant rank before the finite-field zero indicator, or low rank after it, as evidence that the indicator can be compiled compactly.
No implementation or execution is authorized while the paper contract is REVIEW_REQUIRED.
research_question.decision_target: Decide whether the exact five-source equality indicator can be compiled into tensor-train normal form with strict sub-B2 per-target work, traffic, and peak state, or whether every currently explicit route recreates an exact five-sum intersection search at or above that boundary.
research_question.motivation: A complete projective addition circuit gives a constant-rank scalar whose zero set is exactly the ordered five-term decomposition set. The final Boolean tensor is sparse and can itself have low TT rank, but neither fact supplies a compact exact construction. This experiment isolates that compiler gap without the D2 polynomial, scalar source norm, or subset descent.

curve_families: fixed generated ordinary prime-order short-Weierstrass curves
field_types: prime fields with a registered quadratic encoding extension

research_question.title: Exact direct five-source tensor locator
